items.docs:
Convert text to speech using the user's preferred TTS provider.

Args:
    request: TTS request containing text
    current_user: Authenticated user

Returns:
    TTSResponse containing base64 encoded audio data

params.name: text
params.description: Text to convert to speech (max 400 words)

params.name: voice
params.description: Voice override (VOICE_1, VOICE_2, etc). If not provided, uses user's preferred voice

items.docs:
Convert text to speech using OpenAI TTS and stream the audio as MP3.

Args:
    text: Text to convert (query parameter)
    voice: Optional voice override (VOICE_1, VOICE_2, etc)
    current_user: Authenticated user

Returns:
    StreamingResponse with MP3 audio data
